subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配体分类：下列配体属于哪一种 L/X 类型：SIMes (saturated N-heterocyclic carbene)（SIMes）？
A. L
B. X
C. LX₂
D. X₃
explanation: SIMes (SIMes (saturated N-heterocyclic carbene)) is an L ligand: each L gives 2 electrons and each X one, so 2 electrons in the covalent count (2 in the ionic count).
